gloss: new and old; the old and the new

definitions.gloss: new and old; the old and the new
definitions.explanation: A pair word referring to both new and old things, often implying comparison or transition between them.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}{両方|りょうほう}ある。
examples.english: There are both old and new ones.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}が{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The old and new changed dramatically.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}の{対比|たいひ}が{面白|おもしろ}い。
examples.english: The contrast between new and old is interesting.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}{交代|こうたい}の{時期|じき}がやってきた。
examples.english: The time for the changing of the guard has come.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}には{新旧|しんきゅう}の{建物|たてもの}が{並|なら}んでいて、{歩|ある}いているだけで{歴史|れきし}を{感|かん}じることができる。
examples.english: In this town, old and new buildings stand side by side, and just walking around you can feel the history.

notes:
COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
{新|しん} (new) + {旧|きゅう} (old)
A typical opposite-pair compound ({対義語|たいぎご} compound)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新旧|しんきゅう}{交代|こうたい}: changing of old and new (handover)
- {新旧|しんきゅう}の{対比|たいひ}: contrast between old and new
- {新旧|しんきゅう}{入|い}れ{替|か}え: replacing old with new

SIMILAR PAIR WORDS:
- {大小|だいしょう}: large and small
- {長短|ちょうたん}: long and short
- {善悪|ぜんあく}: good and evil
